text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Daring Tact and I made 
our way 
to an amusement park. All to help grant 
her wish 
of socializing with a wider variety of 
people.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Socializing at an amusement park...? 
Do you mean... while enjoying an 
attraction?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. In an interactive roleplay mystery 
attraction!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A theatrical attraction where participants 
step into the shoes of characters 
to solve a mystery. Clearing it requires 
communicating 
with NPCs and other participants alike.
choice_data_list:
I figured it'd be a great way to branch 
out and socialize.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that makes me so happy! 
I'm a little nervous, but I'll do my 
best...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The mystery attraction even provides 
costumes suited to each role, 
making it quite an authentic production. 
While we wait for the other participants 
who will form our team—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, Daring Tact? 
What an unexpected coincidence...! 
I look forward to working with you as 
teammates.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah?! The pleasure is all mine, 
I look forward to working with you...!
choice_data_list:
Glad to have you! Right off the bat, are 
there any roles you'd prefer?

Glad to have you! Right off the bat, are 
there any roles you'd prefer?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If it is agreeable, I would like to be the 
journalist. Since this is a mystery, 
I imagine gathering information will be of 
paramount importance.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That makes so much sense...! Just as 
expected of you, Air Messiah. 
In that case, I would love to play the 
doctor.
choice_data_list: Then I guess I'll take the merchant role.
Then I guess I'll take the merchant role.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Our roles were decided quite swiftly. 
I have a feeling things will proceed 
smoothly from here on.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Indeed...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both of them seem slightly stiff, if only 
a little. 
Daring Tact and Air Messiah should be 
reasonably well acquainted, 
so I wonder why.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we often speak together whenever 
Daring Heart is around, 
but having personal conversations just 
between the two of us 
hasn't happened very often...
choice_data_list:
I see, so you haven't had many deep 
conversations together...

I see, so you haven't had many deep 
conversations together...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, aiming for a closer 
bond with Air Messiah today 
might be a great goal. 
Time to lend her my support!
choice_data_list:
(First, I need to create an easygoing 
atmosphere!)

text_block_list.name: Steampunk NPC
text_block_list.text:
—Give that book back! 
That belonged to a genius alchemist... 
It's utterly wasted in the hands of an 
amateur like you!
choice_data_list:
Very well. Provided you can pay a suitable 
price, that is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! Trai... I mean, Merchant! 
If you sell that book, then...!
choice_data_list:
Though can you actually afford it? 
Eeheehee!

text_block_list.name: Steampunk NPC
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Taking advantage of me like that. 
You crooked merchant! You'll regret this!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
.........A crooked... merchant... 
Pfft, he-hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu! Tore-san, you've gone 
and become a crooked merchant!
choice_data_list:
Why, I'll take that as a compliment. 
Ee-hee-hee!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Th-That laugh... 
Hehe, you make a splendid crooked 
merchant...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I came here today 
believing 
that fully immersing myself in a role 
might help me break out of my shell.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes...—Shall we both head to the newspaper 
office 
where I work to gather information?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! I will also—...um, let's see... 
I am a doctor, I am a doctor, I am a 
doctor...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... There is nothing amiss on the 
medical certificate. 
Could my medical knowledge be lacking...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Does this name ring a bell to you? 
Look, in the article we saw back at the 
newspaper office—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, it was there! 
He was severely injured in a tavern 
brawl... Ah! 
Then there must be a patient chart!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
! That must be it! 
Come, let us make haste to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Steampunk NPC
text_block_list.text:
If you can't cough up the amount I asked 
for, no deal. 
I need funds for my sick daughter's 
surgery... 
Money is all that matters! Surely you 
understand, crooked merchant?
choice_data_list:
Guh... To think my earlier roleplay would 
come back to bite me like this...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So your daughter is ill... 
In that case, I shall treat her! 
For I am a doctor. I can perform surgery!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
! ...If it proves to be a complicated 
ailment, 
I shall gather intelligence on potential 
cures. 
I will arrange everything so the doctor 
can operate.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Could you perhaps allow me to lend a hand?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—We received a jewel in return for the 
treatment. 
That was splendid support, Air Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Only because you suggested healing them, 
Daring Tact. 
I simply felt that offering aid might open 
a way forward...!
choice_data_list:
The quick thinking of both of you saved 
the day!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us take this jewel and the 
alchemist's tome, 
and unravel the final mystery!

text_block_list.name: Steampunk NPC
text_block_list.text:
So this is the eternal flame created 
through alchemy... 
It truly is the solution we have been 
searching for...! 
—Congratulations on clearing the mystery!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact & Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we did it! 
Hehe, we cleared it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That was so much fun...! 
Perhaps because we fully took on our 
roles, 
I was completely immersed in both the 
puzzles and the story!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I, too... was utterly engrossed 
in chasing down the mystery as a 
journalist.
choice_data_list: You were the mastermind behind solving it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You felt like a real reporter outside of 
the puzzles too, 
interviewing us and all. Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was the reporter's spirit, but 
in that moment, 
I felt an urge to uncover the answers to 
every single question...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, we got to talk about so 
many things! 
I feel like we've become much closer than 
before...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Hehe, yes. I feel the same.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I wasn't quite sure how to gauge the 
proper distance 
when trying to socialize with others, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Going through the same experiences and 
sharing that excitement 
might just be what makes it easier to 
bridge the gap.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Next time, even without a puzzle setup 
like this, 
I feel like I'll be able to reach out and 
connect with others...!
choice_data_list:
Go for it! But be careful around 
strangers, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will be careful. 
The folks back home always told me to make 
sure 
I knew whether someone was truly 
trustworthy or not.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If I ever find myself unsure... 
I'll be sure to consult you, Tore-san!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It is all thanks to you, Tore-san. 
Not just for brainstorming ways for me to 
socialize, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It felt like such a chic, city pastime, 
and it was so thrilling! 
Hehe, I can't wait to tell my little 
sisters all about it.
